redaction: Only what the replay reads. A row of a person stored in the shard (same address or same name) keeps slug, full_name, title, email and profile_url. A row the PHHP gate publishes (before or after it read HR shorthand titles) whose person is not stored keeps its title under an opaque stand-in slug, name (first name chosen to land in the same unit) and address. Every other row keeps only an opaque stand-in slug, the key the walk counts distinct rows by. research_interests is dropped. Stored rows keep identity, contact and activity fields only.
